newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Eco-Systems net loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Eco-Systems net loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Net income for the fiscal 1997 included non-recurring charges of $4,120,000 from restructuring and adjustments, which include one-time charges of approximately $1.2 million primarily in acquisition-related stock options, approximately $1.1 million in work in progress adjustments for the fourth quarter, a bad debt write-off of approximately $745,000, approximately $375,000 in development expenses for new business, and approximately $700,000 in promotional and acquisition expenses.
Revenues have been restated to account for the poolings of interest with Larco Environmental Services Inc and KR Industrial Service of Alabama Inc during 1996.
